## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement tenant-scoped feature gating, combining CRDs, policy-as-code, and canary-style risk mitigation in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- FeatureGate CRD and TenantFeatureGate per-tenant
- OPA Gatekeeper: ConstraintTemplate and Constraint
- Path-based canary gating and per-tenant isolation
- Minimal YAML for CRD, policy, namespace, and a basic test

## Code Example
```yaml
# FeatureGate CRD (simplified)
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: featuregates.example.org
spec:
  group: example.org
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: featuregates
    singular: featuregate
    kind: FeatureGate
```

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (OPA)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sfeaturegate
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sFeatureGate
  targets:
    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
      rego: |
        package k8sfeaturegate
        violation["deny"] {
          input.target.path == "/v1/beta"
          not input.review.object.metadata.annotations["tenant/feature-v1-beta"] == "enabled"
        }
```

```yaml
# Constraint (per-tenant)
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sFeatureGate
metadata:
  name: tenant-v1beta-enabled
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
      - apiGroups: ["gateway.example.org"]
        kinds: ["GatewayRoute"]
  parameters:
    # feature flag key used in tenant annotation
    flagKey: "tenant/feature-v1-beta"
```

```yaml
# Namespace manifest enabling the flag
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  annotations:
    tenant/feature-v1-beta: enabled
```

```bash
# quick test (pseudo)
curl -H "Host: gateway.example.org" https://gateway/health
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example
```yaml
# ConfigMap example
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf.canary
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  enabled: "true"
  target: "/v1/foo"
```
```yaml
# Sidecar snippet (pseudo)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-sidecar
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: sidecar
        image: cnf/sidecar:latest
        env:
        - name: CANARY_ENABLED
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:

          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.canary
              key: target
```

- What are potential race conditions with ConfigMap updates and how would you mitigate them?

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate: CNFImageVuln
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: cnfimagevuln
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: CNFImageVuln
      scope: Cluster
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package cnfimagevuln
      violation[{"msg": msg}]
      # image.vulns is a list of {cve, cvss}
      violation[{"msg": msg}]
      {
        input.review.object.kind == "Deployment";
        ns := input.review.object.metadata.namespace;
        threshold := data.namespaceThresholds[ns];
        some i;
        vul := input.review.object.metadata.annotations["image.vulns"];
        cvss := vul[i].cvss;
        cvss > threshold; msg := sprintf("CVSS %v exceeds threshold %v for namespace %s", [cvss, threshold, ns]);
      }
```

```yaml
    - {key: "cnf.namespace", operator: In, values: ["default"]}
```

```go
func AdaptiveSampler(sampleRate float64, errorRate float64) float64 {
    baseRate := sampleRate
    if errorRate > 0.05 {
        return min(1.0, baseRate*2)
    }
    return baseRate
}
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:

```
